overview: A modern AI-powered translation application that enables real-time text translation between multiple languages. Built with a React frontend and Node.js/Express backend, it leverages Cohere's AI language models to provide accurate translations with an intuitive and responsive user interface.
metrics: 5 supported languages (Spanish, English, German, French, Italian)
Full-stack architecture with separate frontend/backend services
challenges: Integrating AI translation service with optimal prompt engineering for accurate results
Implementing responsive design that works seamlessly across desktop and mobile devices
Managing API rate limits and error handling for external AI service dependencies
Creating an intuitive UX with real-time feedback and loading states
Handling character encoding and special characters in multilingual text processing
features: Real-time text translation between 5 languages (ES, EN, DE, FR, IT)
Clean and responsive user interface with TailwindCSS styling
Input validation with 300 character limit and real-time feedback
Loading states and error handling with toast notifications
Language selection dropdown with immediate translation capabilities
Cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) configured for web deployment
Environment-based API configuration for development and production
TypeScript implementation for type safety across the entire stack

architecture.details: The application follows a clean separation of concerns with a React frontend communicating with a Node.js/Express backend via REST API. The backend integrates with Cohere's AI service using carefully crafted prompts for each target language. The frontend features a responsive design with real-time state management, while the backend handles API requests, translation processing, and error management. Both services are built with TypeScript for enhanced developer experience and code reliability.
